terms.comment: Our descriptive formation: a plastic anchor for a wall. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a wall plug (searched under wall plug, wall anchor and dowel). Plasticus is classically “of moulding” (Vitr., in Lewis & Short); of the material it is modern.

phrases.latin: Ancoram mūrālem plasticam in forāmen pōne.
phrases.english: Put the plastic wall plug into the hole.

sources: Our provisional descriptive formation; no exact equivalent was found in the Latin sources checked.
